mechanism_narrative: A sustained downward trend in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in the majority of periods with declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 5.0% in a single month, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in manufacturing production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates a broad-based economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The negative return prediction fails when both INDPRO and HOUST decline simultaneously in more than 60% of cases (i.e., SPX returns are positive in >60% of such instances).

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, characterized by three consecutive monthly increases in the federal funds rate, the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to higher discount rates and reduced liquidity.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative during periods of three consecutive FEDFUNDS increases (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A positive trend in quarterly real GDP growth (GDPC1) signals strong economic expansion, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive in periods of rising GDPC1 (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in the CPI (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflation that prompts the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates weakening labor market and consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The negative return prediction fails when both PAYEMS and RSAFS decline simultaneously in more than 60% of cases (i.e., SPX returns are positive in >60% of such instances).

mechanism_narrative: In a manufacturing contraction regime, defined by three consecutive monthly declines in industrial production (INDPRO), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate output and earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative during periods of three consecutive INDPRO declines (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
